categories.main_business_segments: Fukui Computer Holdings operates four main business segments: Architectural System Business (developing and selling software for architectural design, estimation, and documentation), Surveying and Civil Engineering System Business (developing and selling software for surveying, land and building measurement, and civil engineering project management), IT Solutions Business (developing mobile and web applications, notably for election exit polls), and Investment Business (corporate venture capital investments in construction tech startups and related ventures).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include proprietary CAD systems for architecture (e.g., ARCHITREND, GLOOBE) and civil engineering (e.g., TREND-ONE, TREND-CORE), cloud-based data management platforms, and advanced 3D measurement and modeling tools. Production methods emphasize in-house software development, integration of AI and XR technologies, and collaboration with academic institutions for infrastructure management solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are businesses in the construction industry, including architectural design offices, construction firms, house builders, general contractors, surveying companies, land and house investigators, and public sector clients. The company also serves consultants and government agencies involved in infrastructure projects, as well as organizations requiring IT solutions for event management and elections.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Japan, with nearly all sales and assets located domestically. The company previously had a subsidiary in Shanghai but currently focuses on the Japanese market, with minor international investment activities through its CVC arm.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fukui Computer Holdings operates downstream in the supply chain, providing end-user software solutions and services directly to construction, surveying, and civil engineering firms, as well as public sector clients. It also acts as a solution integrator and platform provider within the construction industry ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding core CAD and data platform businesses, launching new service platforms (such as FC Apps Direct), supporting construction industry DX (digital transformation), and investing in innovative construction tech startups. R&D focuses on cloud services, AI, XR, BIM/CIM, automation for productivity, and integration with regulatory and environmental requirements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of packaged software products, maintenance and support contracts (recurring revenue), cloud service subscriptions, and IT solution projects. Additional revenue streams include investment returns from the CVC business and, to a lesser extent, hardware and equipment sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other Japanese and global providers of construction and civil engineering software, such as Autodesk, Bentley Systems, and local CAD vendors. Fukui Computer Holdings holds a strong market share in Japan’s architectural and surveying CAD segments, positioning itself as a leading domestic provider with a focus on industry-specific solutions and regulatory compliance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached 14.7 billion yen (up 6.5% year-on-year), with operating profit of 6.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 4.2 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth, high profitability (operating margin over 40%), and maintains a robust financial position with an equity ratio of 82% and over 21 billion yen in cash and equivalents.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fukui Computer Holdings differentiates itself through deep specialization in the Japanese construction, surveying, and civil engineering sectors, offering highly localized, regulation-compliant, and workflow-integrated software solutions. Its value proposition centers on enabling digital transformation, productivity gains, and compliance for industry professionals, supported by strong after-sales service and continuous innovation in response to evolving market and regulatory needs.
